section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 5. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 13.9 | 7.0 | 200 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 14.0 | 7.0 | 200 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 13.4 | 6.7 | 200 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
